what_this_shows: A real cross-fade in a real browser. The engine decided which track survives the exclusive switch and how far into each fade every frame is; the page only multiplied that out into a gain. Checked against the declaration: bgm has fade_out_frames 60 and fade_in_frames 30, and both sources start at volume 0.6. At frame 189, 10 frames into the fade-out, 0.6 * (1 - 10/60) = 0.5; the fade-in is 10 frames into 30, 0.6 * 10/30 = 0.2. Both match.

samples.note: the fade ended and the engine retired the source; the host stopped its node
